nodes.description: Constant mint price of 0.05 ETH per NFT used to validate msg.value in mint.
Constant cap of 5 tokens per mint transaction.
Mutable maximum token supply, settable by the owner and used in mint and calcStartingIndex.
Boolean sale switch toggled by flipSaleState and required to be true in mint.
Provenance/starting index derived from a stored block hash in calcStartingIndex.
Block number recorded at reserve/emergency time and later consumed by calcStartingIndex.
Private extended base URI written by setBaseURI and read by _baseURI.
Mapping of tokenId to individual override URI read by tokenURI.
Owner-only toggle of the saleIsActive flag.
Owner-only function that forwards the full contract balance to msg.sender via transfer.
Owner-only function that mints num tokens to msg.sender starting at totalSupply and stamps startingIndexBlock.
Owner-only setter that overwrites MAX_SUPPLY without any upper bound.
Payable public mint function validating sale state, amount, supply, purchase cap and exact msg.value.
Owner-only reveal function deriving startingIndex from blockhash(startingIndexBlock) modulo MAX_SUPPLY.
Owner-only fallback that stores block.number as startingIndexBlock.
Internal override returning the extended base URI string.
Owner-only setter for the extended base URI.
View function returning the per-token or base-derived metadata URI.
Internal library mint that mints a token and then validates the receiver via _checkOnERC721Received.
Internal callback dispatcher that calls onERC721Received on contract recipients after an extcodesize check.
Caller-controlled address used for owner checks, mint recipient and payout destination.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance) external value transfer in withdraw.
External call to IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received executed before state finalisation, enabling reentrancy.
SafeMath helpers add/sub/mul and tryAdd/trySub/tryMul perform arithmetic inside unchecked blocks.
Inline assembly extcodesize used by Address.isContract to decide whether to run the receiver callback.
Number of tokens to reserve in reserveTokens.
New maximum supply passed to setMaxTokenSupply.
Number of tokens requested in mint (capped at MAX_NFT_PURCHASE).
New base URI string passed to setBaseURI.
Token identifier queried in tokenURI.
Previous owner forwarded into the receiver callback.
Recipient address on which onERC721Received is invoked.
Cached address(this).balance forwarded by withdraw.
totalSupply() snapshot used as base id for reserved mints.
Loop counter of the reserveTokens mint loop.
Loop counter of the mint loop.
Per-token URI override read from _tokenURIs.
Base URI obtained from _baseURI inside tokenURI.

edges.reason: flipSaleState is guarded by onlyOwner and toggles saleIsActive.
flipSaleState writes the negated saleIsActive flag.
mint reads saleIsActive in its first require.
withdraw compares owner() to msg.sender and forwards funds to msg.sender.
withdraw executes payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance).
Local balance is the amount passed to the value transfer.
mint mints every token to msg.sender.
numberOfTokensMax5 controls supply, price and loop iterations in mint.
mint loop is driven by the local counter i.
mint enforces totalSupply().add(amount) <= MAX_SUPPLY.
mint enforces numberOfTokensMax5 <= MAX_NFT_PURCHASE.
mint requires NFT_PRICE.mul(numberOfTokensMax5) == msg.value.
mint relies on SafeMath add/mul which perform arithmetic inside unchecked blocks.
mint calls _safeMint(msg.sender, totalSupply()) in the loop.
reserveTokens is onlyOwner and mints reserved tokens to msg.sender.
num bounds the reserve mint loop.
supply snapshot seeds the minted token ids in reserveTokens.
reserve loop counter i drives the reserve mints.
reserveTokens calls _safeMint for each reserved token.
reserveTokens sets startingIndexBlock = block.number when unset.
_safeMint delegates receiver validation to _checkOnERC721Received.
_checkOnERC721Received makes an external callback into untrusted recipient code.
_msgSender() is forwarded as operator into onERC721Received.
from parameter is forwarded into the receiver callback.
to parameter is the untrusted contract that receives the callback.
_checkOnERC721Received gates the callback on Address.isContract (extcodesize).
maxSupply parameter is written by the onlyOwner setMaxTokenSupply.
setMaxTokenSupply overwrites MAX_SUPPLY without validation.
calcStartingIndex requires startingIndex to still be zero.
calcStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock for blockhash randomness.
calcStartingIndex writes the derived startingIndex.
calcStartingIndex uses SafeMath sub/add unchecked wrappers.
startingIndex is computed modulo MAX_SUPPLY and clamps zero to one.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock stores block.number into startingIndexBlock.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is onlyOwner and requires startingIndex == 0.
_baseURI returns the _baseURIExtended state variable.
baseURI_ argument is assigned inside setBaseURI.
onlyOwner setBaseURI writes _baseURIExtended.
The onlyOwner gate compares owner() with msg.sender for setBaseURI.
tokenURI loads the per-token override from _tokenURIs.
tokenId parameter indexes the URI lookups in tokenURI.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to fetch the base string.
Local base is concatenated into the returned URI.
tokenURI reads the _tokenURIs mapping for the requested tokenId.

normalization_plan.reason: num is a transaction parameter that only exists to bound the reserve mint loop, so it inherits the reserveTokens behaviour.
maxSupply is the single argument that directly overwrites MAX_SUPPLY in the owner setter.
numberOfTokensMax5 is the payable mint argument controlling price, supply and loop count, so it collapses into mint.
baseURI_ is the only input assigned to _baseURIExtended by the owner setter.
tokenId is only used to index URI lookups inside tokenURI.
from is forwarded verbatim into the untrusted receiver callback.
to is the untrusted recipient on which the callback is executed.
The cached balance is the exact value passed to the ETH transfer operation in withdraw.
supply is a temporary totalSupply snapshot used to derive reserved token ids.
i is the reserve mint loop counter and carries no independent semantics.
i is the mint loop counter scoped entirely to the mint function.
_tokenURI is a temporary read of the per-token URI override inside tokenURI.
base is a temporary read of _baseURI used only for string concatenation in tokenURI.
